character: An old tengu man, crow-headed, feathers gone ash-grey and thin, a crooked forefinger. Bright sharp eyes. Humming, beak slightly open.
wardrobe: A worn leather tender's apron hung with smooth brass tools, a woollen scarf.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing with a lantern raised, the other hand pointing.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Touching a brass plate in a curving ancient stone corridor by lantern light, three fingers on the metal, humming.
